exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 blebs 誤認為抹片製作造成的胞質出芽或 ATLL：人為出芽多見於破損細胞且胞質淡；ATLL 核呈花瓣多葉、CD25 強陽性並有 HTLV-1；T-PLL 核圓規則、胞質深嗜鹼。

quiz.q: 這顆細胞胞質邊緣的圓形泡狀突起叫什麼？為確認 T-PLL，最具診斷性的 FISH 檢查目標基因是？

61609.recognize_zh: 周邊血中可見一個中型芽細胞，核佔大部分、染色質細緻，胞質少量呈深藍色、無明顯顆粒，提示血中出現芽細胞；系列歸屬與 CEBPA 突變需流式與分子檢測。
features: Single medium-sized blast with high N:C ratio
Round to slightly irregular nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin
Scant, deeply basophilic cytoplasm without visible granules or Auer rods
Background red cells with crenation (echinocytic artifact) and mild anisocytosis
Platelets not conspicuous in this field
61609.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a circulating blast of medium size with a high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, and a thin rim of deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods are identified. Background red cells show crenation, likely artifactual, and platelets are not conspicuous. In the context of the bone marrow findings, this is consistent with circulating myeloblasts of acute myeloid leukemia; lineage and the CEBPA mutation require flow cytometry and molecular testing.

ddx.vs: Agranular myeloblasts and lymphoblasts overlap morphologically; MPO and flow cytometry (CD13/CD33/CD117 vs CD19/CD10/cyCD3) are needed.
Reactive lymphocytes have more condensed chromatin and more abundant cytoplasm with peripheral basophilia, without fine blastic chromatin.
LGLs have mature condensed chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm with azurophilic granules.

61545.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD20 免疫染色只標出零星小型反應性 B 細胞（膜染色），而帶有大囊泡狀核與明顯核仁的大型非典型細胞則為 CD20 陰性，這種模式支持古典型何杰金淋巴瘤（CHL）的 HRS 細胞。
features: Only rare scattered small cells show membranous CD20 staining (background reactive B cells)
Large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli are CD20 negative
Polymorphous background of small lymphocytes, histiocytes and stromal cells, all negative
Loose, somewhat edematous/fibrotic stroma without normal hematopoietic elements in this field
61545.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 on a bone marrow biopsy shows a polymorphous infiltrate in a loose fibrotic stroma. Only rare scattered small lymphocytes show membranous CD20 positivity, while the large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli are negative. There is no sheet of CD20-positive large cells. In conjunction with CD30 and CD15 positivity and weak PAX5 in the large cells, findings support marrow involvement by classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: In THRLBCL the scattered large neoplastic cells are strongly CD20+ with CD30/CD15 negativity, whereas here the large cells are CD20-negative.
LP cells are strongly CD20+ and set in B-cell-rich nodules, unlike the CD20-negative large cells here.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma with HRS-like cells
ddx.vs: PTCL shows an atypical CD3+ T-cell background with aberrant antigen loss, and HRS-like cells are often EBV+ B cells, requiring T-cell markers and clonality to separate.

61481.recognize_zh: 血片中大量中型淋巴樣細胞取代正常白血球（僅見一顆中性球作大小對照），核圓或略凹陷、染色質粗塊狀、細胞質中等量淡藍，形態一致，符合成熟 B 細胞淋巴瘤白血化；標題中的 Auer 樣棒狀內含物在此解析度下無法確認。
features: Numerous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells, slightly smaller than the single segmented neutrophil present
Round, oval or slightly indented nuclei with coarsely clumped chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Moderate amount of pale blue cytoplasm, some cells with a slightly eccentric nucleus
Eosinophilic Auer rod-like cytoplasmic crystals described clinically are not definitively visible at this resolution
No blasts, smudge cells or red cell agglutination/rouleaux evident
61481.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows lymphocytosis composed of monotonous intermediate-sized lymphoid cells with round to slightly indented nuclei, coarsely clumped chromatin and a moderate amount of pale basophilic cytoplasm; a single segmented neutrophil provides a size reference. The eosinophilic, needle-like Auer rod-like inclusions reported in this case cannot be convincingly identified at this image resolution. There are no blasts or smudge cells. Together with the monoclonal B-cell population on flow cytometry, the findings are consistent with a low-grade B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase, with crystalline immunoglobulin inclusions raising lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma in the differential.

ddx.vs: AML blasts have fine chromatin, nucleoli and MPO-positive azurophilic Auer rods, whereas these mature-appearing lymphocytes carry immunoglobulin crystals.
Plasma cells have eccentric nuclei, perinuclear hofs and deeply basophilic cytoplasm and lack surface CD19/CD20, unlike these lymphocytes.
SMZL cells may show polar villous projections; separation from LPL relies on MYD88 L265P and clinical features rather than morphology alone.
Hairy cells have abundant pale cytoplasm with circumferential hairy projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103/annexin A1 positive.

61417.recognize_zh: MUM1（IRF4）染色低倍（40x）見大型腫瘤結節幾乎全部細胞核陽性、纖維帶陰性；高倍（400x）為瀰漫強烈核染，這種強而一致的 MUM1 表現是 IRF4 重組大B細胞淋巴瘤的關鍵免疫表型線索。
features: Low power (40x): large nodules with diffuse, uniform nuclear MUM1 staining separated by negative fibrous septa
High power (400x): strong nuclear MUM1 in nearly all medium to large tumor cells
Positive nuclei round to oval with variable intensity but near-complete extent
Scattered negative stromal and endothelial cells
61417.describe_en: MUM1 (IRF4) immunohistochemistry demonstrates strong, diffuse nuclear expression in nearly all neoplastic cells within large nodules separated by negative fibrous septa. This uniformly strong MUM1 expression, particularly when co-expressed with BCL6 (and often CD10) in a young patient with nodal or Waldeyer ring disease, raises strong suspicion for large B-cell lymphoma with IRF4 rearrangement, which should be confirmed by IRF4 break-apart FISH.

ddx.vs: Pediatric-type FL is MUM1-negative or weak and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, ABC type
ddx.vs: ABC-type DLBCL is MUM1-positive but usually BCL6/CD10-negative or variable and lacks IRF4 rearrangement.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is MUM1-positive but CD20/PAX5-negative, CD138-positive and often EBER-positive.

61353.recognize_zh: 十二指腸黏膜低倍下，可見緊貼絨毛下方、位於黏膜層的大型淋巴濾泡結節，濾泡內細胞單調、缺乏明顯的極性分區，在十二指腸活檢中出現這種濾泡應考慮十二指腸型濾泡性淋巴瘤，需 CD10/BCL2 染色確認。
features: Duodenal mucosa with preserved villi and surface epithelium
Large, expansile lymphoid follicle occupying the mucosa and superficial submucosa, with a second smaller follicle at the lower left
Follicles composed of relatively monotonous small cells without obvious zonation or tingible body macrophages at this magnification
Thin rim of darker small lymphocytes around the follicles; lymphoid cells extend into adjacent villous lamina propria
61353.describe_en: Duodenal biopsy shows small-bowel mucosa with preserved villous architecture and large, expansile lymphoid follicles in the mucosa and superficial submucosa. The follicles are composed of relatively monotonous small cells without apparent polarization, and lymphoid cells extend into the lamina propria of adjacent villi. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. The findings are suggestive of duodenal-type follicular lymphoma; immunostains for CD20, CD10, BCL6 and BCL2 (BCL2 positive in germinal centers) with a low Ki-67 index are needed to distinguish it from reactive lymphoid follicles.

ddx.dx: Reactive lymphoid follicles (lymphoid hyperplasia, Peyer patch)
ddx.vs: Reactive germinal centers show polarization, tingible body macrophages and a high Ki-67 index, and are BCL2 negative.
MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells expanding outside follicles with lymphoepithelial lesions and is CD10/BCL6 negative.
Nodules are composed of CD5+/cyclin D1+ monotonous cells rather than CD10+/BCL6+ follicle center cells.

ddx.dx: Systemic (nodal) follicular lymphoma with secondary GI involvement
ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps; staging showing nodal or systemic disease and lack of IgA/CCR9 mucosal homing features separate it from localized duodenal-type FL.

61289.recognize_zh: 四個大型母細胞，核圓形偏心、染色質細緻並可見明顯核仁，細胞質豐富、灰藍色且無顆粒，核周無明顯淡染區；大型、細胞質多的無顆粒母細胞是單核母細胞（monoblast）的典型外觀。
features: Large blasts with round, often eccentric nuclei
Fine chromatin with distinct nucleoli
Moderate to abundant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm
No Auer rods or significant vacuolation seen
Background red cells with overlapping areas and a few platelets
61289.describe_en: Smear shows four large blasts with round, eccentrically placed nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, distinct nucleoli, and moderate to abundant grey-blue agranular cytoplasm. Auer rods and cytoplasmic vacuoles are not seen. The background contains red cells and scattered platelets. The morphology is consistent with monoblasts, supporting acute monoblastic leukemia (FAB M5a) in the appropriate context; confirmation with nonspecific esterase and monocytic flow cytometry markers is recommended.

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and express CD138, lacking monocytic markers.
Myeloblasts have less cytoplasm, may contain azurophilic granules or Auer rods, and are MPO-strong with maturing granulocytes present.
Megakaryoblasts show cytoplasmic blebs and are CD41/CD61-positive rather than CD14/CD64-positive.

61225.recognize_zh: 高倍 H&E 下為瀰漫成片、單一形態的小至中型淋巴樣細胞，核形不規則、有摺痕，夾雜細小血管，屬於侵襲性淋巴瘤浸潤；本視野未見腺體。
features: Diffuse sheets of monotonous small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells
Irregular, folded to angulated nuclei with moderately dense chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale cytoplasm with occasional clear spaces between cells
Scattered small capillaries with red cells; no residual glands in this field
No prominent necrosis visible in this field
61225.describe_en: High-power H&E section shows a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphoid cells with irregular, folded nuclear contours, moderately dense chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, traversed by small capillaries. Residual glands are not present in this field, and necrosis is not evident here. The morphology indicates a lymphoma; with the accompanying CD3+, CD56+, CD4-/CD5-/CD8- and EBER+ immunoprofile, the findings are consistent with extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type.

ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and express CD20/PAX5 rather than CD3/CD56.
PTCL-NOS can look identical on H&E but is typically CD56 negative and EBER negative.
Lymphoblasts have fine blastic chromatin with frequent mitoses and express TdT and CD34/CD99.
Carcinoma shows cohesive nests and cytokeratin positivity, unlike this discohesive lymphoid sheet.

61097.recognize_zh: 同一骨髓同時有兩群異常細胞：抹片中有芽細胞與漿細胞混雜，流式細胞儀一群為 CD38+/CD56+ 且細胞質 lambda 輕鏈限制（94.33%）的漿細胞，另一群為 CD34+/CD117+/HLA-DR+/CD123+ 的骨髓芽細胞。
features: Core biopsy (A): hypercellular marrow with increased immature mononuclear cells and plasma cells (asterisks/arrows mark cells of interest)
IHC (B): interstitially scattered positive cells throughout the marrow (antibody not labeled)
Aspirate (C, D): blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and nucleoli admixed with plasma cells showing eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm
Flow (E, F): plasma cell population CD38 bright/CD56 positive with cytoplasmic lambda restriction (94.33% lambda vs 0.06% kappa)
Flow (G–I): myeloblast population CD34+, CD123+, CD117+, HLA-DR+, CD38+
Two distinct neoplastic populations coexist in one marrow
61097.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy is hypercellular with increased immature mononuclear cells and interstitial plasma cells. The aspirate shows blasts with fine chromatin and nucleoli admixed with atypical plasma cells. Flow cytometry demonstrates two abnormal populations: CD38+/CD56+ plasma cells with cytoplasmic lambda light-chain restriction, and CD34+/CD117+/HLA-DR+/CD123+ myeloblasts. Although blasts are below 20%, in a patient with prior cytotoxic therapy, findings are suggestive of therapy-related myeloid neoplasm (AML-defining genetics or disease-defining criteria should be sought) with concomitant lambda-restricted plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology only
ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are CD38/CD138+ with light-chain restriction and lack CD34/CD117/HLA-DR, so the separate CD34+ myeloblast population excludes this as the sole explanation.
Separation from t-AML at 8% blasts depends on AML-defining genetic abnormalities (e.g., KMT2A, NUP98 rearrangement) rather than morphology.
Regenerating marrow shows maturing myeloid precursors and a normal-pattern CD34+ population without aberrant antigen expression or a clonal cytogenetic lesion.

61033.recognize_zh: 淋巴結免疫染色：胞質透明的中型非典型細胞 CD4 及 CD5 僅呈淡的膜染色（白箭頭），而背景小型反應性 T 細胞強陽性（黑箭頭）；CD8 只染出散在的小淋巴球，顯示腫瘤 T 細胞抗原表現減弱，支持 AITL。
features: Medium-to-large atypical cells with clear cytoplasm showing dim/weak membranous CD4 (white arrows)
Same clear cells show dim CD5, weaker than the strongly stained small background T cells (black arrows)
Small reactive T cells with strong CD5 staining clustered between neoplastic cells
CD8 marks numerous scattered small reactive T cells, negative in the large clear cells
Polymorphous background with vessels visible between cells
61033.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stains on lymph node sections show that the atypical medium-to-large cells with clear cytoplasm express CD4 and CD5 with dim membranous intensity, compared with strongly stained small reactive T cells. CD8 highlights a substantial population of small, scattered reactive cytotoxic T cells and is negative in the neoplastic cells. Diminished expression of pan-T-cell antigens in the CD4-positive clear cells is an aberrant phenotype supporting a T-cell lymphoma, consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells retain bright, uniform pan-T antigens without a distinct population showing dim CD4/CD5.
PTCL-NOS can show antigen loss but lacks co-expression of TFH markers (PD-1, CD10, CXCL13) and expanded FDC meshworks.
ATLL is CD4+/CD25+ with frequent CD7 loss in HTLV-1 seropositive patients and lacks the TFH phenotype.

60969.recognize_zh: 小淋巴球背景中散在大型、核分葉或核圓帶多個核仁的 LP 細胞（爆米花細胞），周圍被小淋巴球緊密環繞成玫瑰花環；CD20 大細胞陽性但環繞的小細胞陰性，CD3 與 PD-1 則標出環繞的 TFH 細胞，是 NLPHL 的典型「T 細胞玫瑰花環」。
features: Panel A (H&E): scattered large atypical cells with multilobulated (popcorn) or large round vesicular nuclei and small nucleoli, in a background of small mature lymphocytes
Large cells tightly encircled by small lymphocytes forming rosettes; occasional histiocytes
Panel B (CD20): large cells membranous positive (arrows) with many CD20-positive background B cells, but the immediately rosetting lymphocytes are negative
Panel C (CD3): T cells forming a ring around a central unstained large cell (arrow)
Panel D (PD-1): PD-1-positive T cells rosetting around large cells (arrows)
60969.describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows scattered large atypical cells with multilobated popcorn-like or large round nuclei with small nucleoli, set in a background of small lymphocytes. The large cells are tightly ringed by small lymphocytes forming rosettes. Immunostains show the large cells and many background small lymphocytes to be CD20 positive, whereas the rosetting cells are CD20 negative and CD3 and PD-1 positive, consistent with follicular helper T cells. In combination with the reported nodular architecture and PAX5/BCL6 positivity with CD30/CD15 negativity, the findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30/CD15-positive with weak/absent CD20 and PAX5 dim, although CD3/PD-1 rosettes can also be seen.
Diffuse pattern with scattered large B cells in a background of CD8-positive T cells and histiocytes, lacking a CD20-rich small B-cell meshwork and PD-1 rosettes.
Enlarged nodules of small mantle B cells without LP cells or PD-1-positive rosettes around large atypical cells.
Neoplastic follicles are composed of monotonous BCL2-positive centrocytes/centroblasts rather than scattered popcorn cells within small-lymphocyte nodules.

exam.answer_en: Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma — CD20+ LP (popcorn) cells ringed by CD3+/PD-1+ follicular helper T-cell rosettes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指被小淋巴球環繞的大細胞問名稱 → LP cell（popcorn cell），再問環繞細胞的身分 → CD3+、PD-1+（亦常 CD57+）的 follicular helper T cells。
LP cell 表型：CD20+、PAX5+、CD79a+、OCT2+、BOB1+、BCL6+、CD45+，CD15−、CD30−；與 classic HL 的 Reed-Sternberg cell（CD15+/CD30+、CD20 多陰性、CD45−）相反。
命名：ICC 2022 改稱 nodular lymphocyte predominant B-cell lymphoma，WHO 5th 仍保留 NLPHL；生長模式（Fan pattern）中瀰漫、富含 T 細胞的變異型與較差預後相關。
臨床多為惰性、局部頸部淋巴結病灶，可晚期復發或轉化為 T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma；CD20 陽性使 rituximab 可納入治療。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 lymphocyte-rich classic HL 混淆：後者 RS 細胞 CD30+/CD15+、CD20 多陰性，背景小 B 細胞結節中無 PD-1+ 玫瑰花環；也要與 THRLBCL（背景缺乏小 B 細胞網絡）區分。

quiz.q: 圖中被小淋巴球環繞成玫瑰花環的大型細胞叫什麼？環繞的小淋巴球表現哪些標記？
quiz.a: LP cell（popcorn cell）；CD3+、PD-1+（常 CD57+）的 follicular helper T cells

60905.recognize_zh: 巴瑞特食道（可見杯狀細胞的腸化生腺體）的固有層被大量細胞質充滿嗜酸性球狀物的漿細胞（Mott cells／Russell bodies）撐開；漿細胞標記強陽性，kappa/lambda 雙色原位雜交呈混合表現，支持反應性而非單株性漿細胞增生。
features: Glandular mucosa with intestinal metaplasia (goblet cells) and lamina propria expanded by a cellular infiltrate
High power: sheets of plasma cells with abundant eosinophilic, glassy cytoplasm distended by Russell bodies, pushing nuclei eccentrically
IHC (panel C) highlights a dense cluster of plasma cells in the lamina propria
Dual kappa/lambda staining (panel D) shows admixed brown and red positive cells, indicating polytypic plasma cells
No destructive lymphoepithelial lesions or atypical lymphoid infiltrate evident
60905.describe_en: Esophageal glandular mucosa with intestinal metaplasia shows the lamina propria expanded by an infiltrate of plasma cells. At high power, many plasma cells contain abundant eosinophilic globular cytoplasmic inclusions (Russell bodies), forming Mott cells with eccentric compressed nuclei. Immunohistochemistry highlights the plasma cell aggregate, and dual kappa/lambda staining shows a mixture of kappa- and lambda-expressing cells without light-chain restriction. Findings are consistent with reactive Mott cell (Russell body) plasmacytosis in Barrett esophagus, sometimes termed Russell body gastritis/esophagitis.

ddx.dx: Extranodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows a dense atypical B-cell infiltrate with lymphoepithelial lesions and light-chain-restricted plasma cells, unlike the polytypic plasma cells here.
Signet ring cells contain mucin vacuoles that indent the nucleus and are keratin positive, whereas Mott cells have eosinophilic immunoglobulin globules and are CD138 positive/keratin negative.
Plasmacytoma forms a mass of monotypic plasma cells, while this infiltrate is polytypic by kappa/lambda staining.
These contain granular or foamy cytoplasm without Russell bodies and are S100 or CD68 positive rather than plasma cell markers.

60841.recognize_zh: 上方為含空泡、細胞碎屑與退化嗜中性球的壞死帶，下方為排列成漩渦狀、胞核細長的類上皮組織球層，兩者交界清楚，屬壞死性肉芽腫的邊緣。
features: Sharp interface between a necrotic zone (top) and a granulomatous rim (bottom)
Necrotic zone with nuclear debris, degenerating neutrophils and foamy/vacuolated histiocytes with clear spaces
Epithelioid histiocytes with elongated, oval to spindle, vesicular nuclei in a swirling pattern with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Scattered small lymphocytes among the histiocytes
No giant cells, organisms or atypical large cells evident in this field
60841.describe_en: Section of lymph node at medium power shows the edge of a necrotizing granuloma. The upper portion consists of necrotic debris with degenerating neutrophils, nuclear fragments and vacuolated histiocytes, and is bordered by a band of epithelioid histiocytes with elongated vesicular nuclei arranged in a vaguely palisading, swirling pattern with interspersed lymphocytes. No organisms or cytologically malignant cells are identified on H&E. Findings are consistent with necrotizing granulomatous lymphadenitis; AFB and fungal stains and microbiologic correlation are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cat-scratch lymphadenitis typically has stellate microabscesses with central neutrophils and palisading histiocytes plus monocytoid B-cell hyperplasia; confirmation requires Warthin-Starry stain, PCR or serology.
Kikuchi lacks neutrophils and palisading epithelioid granulomas, instead showing karyorrhectic debris with crescentic histiocytes and CD123+ plasmacytoid dendritic cells.
Fungal infection may look identical on H&E and is distinguished by GMS/PAS demonstration of yeast forms.

60777.recognize_zh: 萎縮退化的濾泡中心細胞少、由樹突狀細胞與一條帶粉紅色玻璃樣物質的小血管穿入，周圍小淋巴球排成一圈圈同心圓狀的被套層（洋蔥皮樣 onion skinning），是透明血管型 Castleman 病的典型濾泡。
features: Regressed (atretic) follicle with a small germinal center depleted of lymphocytes
Germinal center composed mainly of follicular dendritic cells with oval vesicular nuclei and a penetrating small vessel with eosinophilic hyalinized wall
Expanded mantle zone of small mature lymphocytes arranged in concentric layers (onion-skin pattern)
Interfollicular area with small lymphocytes and prominent high endothelial venules
No sheets of plasma cells or atypical large cells in this field
60777.describe_en: Lymph node section shows a regressed follicle with a small, lymphocyte-depleted germinal center composed predominantly of follicular dendritic cells and penetrated by a small vessel with a hyalinized eosinophilic wall. The surrounding mantle zone is expanded, with small lymphocytes arranged in tight concentric rings imparting an onion-skin appearance. The interfollicular region contains small lymphocytes and prominent vessels without sheets of plasma cells. Findings are consistent with hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: Shows regressed follicles as well, but with interfollicular sheets of plasma cells and LANA-positive plasmablasts in the mantle zones, plus systemic symptoms.
Has regressed or hyperplastic follicles with more prominent interfollicular plasmacytosis and systemic inflammation, and is HHV8 negative.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone pattern
ddx.vs: Expanded mantles surround naked germinal centers but consist of monotonous cyclin D1-positive CD5+ B cells rather than polyclonal concentric small lymphocytes.

Regressed follicles with vascular proliferation may be seen, but there is a polymorphous infiltrate of clear atypical T cells expressing TFH markers (PD1, CXCL13) with expanded FDC meshworks outside follicles.

exam.answer_en: Hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease — regressed follicle with penetrating hyalinized vessel ('lollipop') and onion-skin mantle zone
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著穿入萎縮生發中心的玻璃樣小血管（lollipop sign）與同心圓被套層（onion skin），問診斷與亞型；常見延伸是 twinning（一個被套層內含兩個以上生發中心）。
臨床分型比組織型更重要：unicentric CD 多為 hyaline vascular 型、常無全身症狀，手術完整切除通常可治癒；multicentric CD 需再分 HHV8 相關與 idiopathic（iMCD）。
HHV8 檢查：LANA-1 IHC 標出被套層 plasmablasts；HHV8-MCD 常見於 HIV 感染者，治療以 rituximab 為主。iMCD 由 IL-6 驅動，siltuximab 為第一線藥物。
關聯：iMCD 中的 TAFRO 亞型（血小板低下、全身水腫、發燒、骨髓纖維化、器官腫大）；POEMS 症候群可合併 Castleman 樣淋巴結；hyaline vascular CD 可伴 follicular dendritic cell 增生甚至 FDC sarcoma。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 mantle cell lymphoma（mantle zone pattern）混淆：MCL 的擴大被套層是單一形態、CD5+/cyclin D1+ 的單株 B 細胞，而 Castleman 的同心圓小淋巴球為多株、cyclin D1 陰性，且有玻璃樣血管穿入萎縮生發中心。

quiz.q: 圖中小血管穿入萎縮生發中心、周圍小淋巴球排成同心圓，這兩個特徵分別俗稱什麼？最可能的診斷為何？
quiz.a: Lollipop sign 與 onion-skin mantle；hyaline vascular (unicentric) Castleman disease。

60585.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片背景為模糊、粉紫色無定形的物質，細胞輪廓消失只剩染色不清的鬼影細胞與核碎片；切片 H&E 可見大片嗜酸淡染的凝固性壞死區（星號）與骨小樑旁殘存存活骨髓（箭頭），免疫染色仍可在壞死的腫瘤細胞輪廓上顯色，符合 AML 合併骨髓壞死。
features: Aspirate with amorphous, granular pink-purple proteinaceous background and loss of cellular detail
Ghost cells with indistinct borders, smudged or pyknotic nuclear remnants and scattered degenerating cells
Biopsy: extensive coagulative necrosis of marrow spaces (asterisk) with preserved cell outlines, beside viable marrow (arrow)
IHC (marker not labeled): diffuse strong staining of densely packed tumor-cell ghosts, preserving antigenicity in necrotic areas
60585.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show an amorphous, granular eosinophilic-to-basophilic background with poorly preserved ghost cells and nuclear debris, precluding reliable differential counting. The core biopsy shows extensive coagulative necrosis (asterisk) with ghost outlines of densely packed cells adjacent to bony trabeculae, with a small area of viable marrow (arrow). Immunohistochemistry (antibody not labeled in the figure) shows diffuse strong staining of the necrotic cell ghosts, indicating that antigenicity is retained and supporting a blast population. Findings are consistent with extensive bone marrow necrosis in acute myeloid leukemia; repeat sampling from viable areas may be required for full classification.

ddx.dx: Bone marrow necrosis due to metastatic carcinoma
ddx.vs: Ghost cells of carcinoma are keratin positive and often form cohesive clusters, whereas leukemic ghosts express CD34/MPO/CD33.

ddx.dx: Sickle cell crisis or infection-related marrow necrosis
ddx.vs: Necrosis occurs without an underlying blast population, and IHC for blast markers is negative; sickled cells or organisms may be seen.
Shows pale, extracellular Alcian blue-positive mucopolysaccharide with fat atrophy and hypocellularity rather than ghost outlines of densely packed cells.

ddx.dx: Poorly spread/clotted or degenerated aspirate artifact
ddx.vs: Artifacts show clumped platelets or crushed but viable cells, whereas true necrosis shows granular necrotic background confirmed on the biopsy.

60649.recognize_zh: 淋巴結細針抽吸（FNA）抹片中為單一形態、中至大型的淋巴樣細胞，核輕度不規則、染色質細緻，胞質淡藍並含細小嗜天青顆粒，容易誤認為 T/NK 細胞；B 圖 CD20 瀰漫陽性、C 圖 cyclin D1 核陽性並環繞陰性殘存濾泡，確認為被套細胞淋巴瘤（mantle cell lymphoma）。
features: FNA (A): monotonous medium to large lymphoid cells with slightly irregular, notched nuclear contours
Finely dispersed to slightly clumped chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale basophilic cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules
Background of lymphoglandular bodies and scattered red cells; no tingible-body macrophages
Core IHC: diffuse CD20 positivity (B) and nuclear cyclin D1 positivity in the neoplastic cells surrounding a cyclin D1-negative residual follicle (C)
60649.describe_en: Lymph node fine-needle aspirate (panel A) shows a monotonous population of medium to large lymphoid cells with slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli, and a rim of pale cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules, in a background of lymphoglandular bodies. Tingible-body macrophages and a polymorphous reactive population are absent. On the tissue section, the infiltrate is diffusely positive for CD20 (panel B), and cyclin D1 (panel C) shows nuclear staining in the neoplastic cells around a negative residual germinal center, consistent with a mantle zone pattern. Findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma with unusual cytoplasmic granules, emphasizing that granular lymphoid cells are not restricted to T/NK lineage.

ddx.dx: T-cell or NK-cell lymphoma (large granular lymphocytic)
ddx.vs: Granular cytoplasm mimics cytotoxic T/NK cells, but these cells are CD20 and cyclin D1 positive, whereas T/NK lymphomas express CD3/CD2/CD56 and cytotoxic granule proteins.

ddx.dx: Blastoid/pleomorphic MCL versus diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: DLBCL cells are larger with vesicular chromatin and prominent nucleoli and are cyclin D1 negative (or weak) and SOX11 negative.
CLL/SLL has small round cells with clumped chromatin, prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts in proliferation centers, and is CD23 positive and cyclin D1 negative.
Cyclin D1-positive myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei with plasmacytoid cytoplasm and are CD138 positive and CD20 usually negative.

60713.recognize_zh: 周邊血出現大量形態不一的漿細胞：核偏位、細胞質深藍且有大片核旁淡染區，部分核形不規則、有核仁或細胞質空泡；流式顯示 CD38 與 CD138 雙陽性族群，符合多形性漿細胞白血病。
features: Numerous circulating plasma cells of variable size (low power, A), easily outnumbering other leukocytes in the field
Eccentric, round to indented or kidney-shaped nuclei with coarse chromatin, some with a visible nucleolus (F)
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a large pale perinuclear hof, sometimes bulging from the cell (B–D)
Cytoplasmic vacuoles in some cells (E); pleomorphism ranging from small mature to large immature forms
Flow cytometry (G): distinct CD38-bright/CD138-positive population; background red cells with crenation
60713.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large number of circulating plasma cells with marked variation in size and maturity. The cells have eccentric, often indented nuclei with coarse chromatin and occasional nucleoli, abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent perinuclear hofs, and cytoplasmic vacuoles in some cells. Flow cytometry demonstrates a CD38-bright, CD138-positive plasma cell population. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia with pleomorphic morphology; light chain restriction, circulating plasma cell percentage (≥5% defines PCL in current criteria) and high-risk cytogenetics should be documented.

ddx.dx: Reactive plasmacytosis (infection, drug reaction, T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells are small, mature and polytypic by light chain, lacking the pleomorphism and monotypic population of PCL.
LPL shows mostly small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes that are CD19+/CD20+, with plasma cells only a minor component.
Plasmablastic cells are uniformly large immunoblastic cells with central nucleoli, frequently EBV+, rather than a spectrum including mature plasma cells.

ddx.dx: Monocytic or large granular lymphocytic cells
ddx.vs: Monocytes have gray folded nuclei without hofs and are CD14+, while LGLs have azurophilic granules and are CD38/CD138 negative.

captions: Low power: numerous circulating pleomorphic plasma cells
Plasma cell with indented nucleus and large perinuclear hof
Plasma cell with protruding pale hof region
Plasma cell with eccentric nucleus and hof
Plasma cell with cytoplasmic vacuoles
Plasma cell with round nucleus and nucleolus
Flow cytometry: CD38+/CD138+ plasma cell population

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia, pleomorphic — numerous circulating atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, hofs and vacuoles; CD38-bright/CD138+
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指周邊血中大小不一、核偏位、有核旁淡染區的細胞，問「是什麼細胞？達多少可診斷 PCL？」→ plasma cell，≥5%。
IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th 將 plasma cell leukemia 定義為周邊血抹片 circulating plasma cells ≥5%（舊標準為 ≥20%）。
Flow：CD38 bright、CD138+、CD45 陰性或弱、CD19−，需確認 cytoplasmic light chain restriction；PCL 較 myeloma 常見 CD56 陰性。
遺傳學上 PCL 中 t(11;14) 比例較高，亦常見 del(17p)、1q gain 等高風險異常；預後差，需積極誘導並考慮自體移植。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與反應性 plasmacytosis（感染如登革熱、藥物反應）混淆：反應性為 polyclonal、數量少且成熟；PCL 為單株輕鏈限制，常伴 M-protein 與骨髓大量浸潤。

quiz.q: 圖中周邊血的異常細胞是什麼？依現行標準佔周邊血多少比例即可診斷 plasma cell leukemia？

60521.recognize_zh: 視野中以原始細胞為主，其間有數個巨核細胞，細胞質淡染顆粒狀但核呈單一圓形、不分葉且體積偏小（mononuclear/hypolobated megakaryocytes），是 AML with inv(3) 常見的巨核細胞發育異常。
features: Predominance of medium to large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and a rim of basophilic cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes with single round to oval non-lobated nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm
Megakaryocytes are small relative to normal mature megakaryocytes
Occasional maturing neutrophils and small lymphocytes
No Auer rods clearly identified at this magnification
60521.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular specimen dominated by medium to large blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm. Several megakaryocytes are present with single round, non-lobated nuclei and pale granular cytoplasm, and are smaller than normal mature forms. Maturing granulocytes are reduced. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with megakaryocytic dysplasia, suggestive of AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) (GATA2::MECOM) in the appropriate cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Dysplastic mononuclear megakaryocytes occur in both, so cytogenetics showing 3q26 MECOM rearrangement is required to classify as inv(3) AML.
del(5q) MDS has hypolobated megakaryocytes but lacks the large blast population present in this field.
AMKL blasts show cytoplasmic blebs and CD41/CD61 expression, while the blasts here are accompanied by, not composed of, megakaryocytic cells.

exam.answer_en: AML with inv(3)/t(3;3) (GATA2::MECOM) — blasts with small mononuclear, non-lobated megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：指著芽細胞之間體積偏小、單一圓核不分葉的巨核細胞（mononuclear/hypolobated megakaryocytes），問其意義與相關核型。
必考關聯：inv(3)(q21.3q26.2)/t(3;3) → MECOM (EVI1) 被 GATA2 enhancer 活化而過度表現；常合併 monosomy 7，傳統核型或 MECOM break-apart FISH 確認。
臨床特徵：血小板數常正常甚至偏高，與其他 AML 不同；預後屬 adverse risk（ELN 2022），首次緩解後應評估 allogeneic HSCT。
WHO 5th 歸為 AML with MECOM rearrangement（GATA2::MECOM 為代表），屬定義性基因異常、不需 20% 芽細胞門檻；ICC 2022 則要求芽細胞 ≥10%。
exam.pitfall_zh: 單圓核巨核細胞易聯想到 MDS with del(5q)，但 del(5q) 通常芽細胞不增加、巨核細胞體積正常；此圖芽細胞為主，應優先想到 MECOM 重排。

quiz.q: 此骨髓中芽細胞增加，合併小型單一圓核不分葉的巨核細胞，最應排除哪個重現性基因異常？

60457.recognize_zh: CD20 染色下整片小到中型淋巴樣細胞呈均勻一致的膜性陽性，排列緊密、形態單調，只夾雜少數陰性的小血管與組織細胞，確認為瀰漫性 B 細胞淋巴瘤（配合 cyclin D1 判讀為被套細胞淋巴瘤）。
features: Diffuse sheet of small-to-medium lymphoid cells with uniform membranous CD20 positivity
Monotonous cell population without nodular variation in this field
Scattered negative spaces corresponding to small vessels and histiocytes
No residual germinal centers or T-cell zones apparent
60457.describe_en: CD20 immunostain shows diffuse, uniform membranous positivity in a densely packed, monotonous population of small-to-medium lymphoid cells. Only scattered negative foci corresponding to small vessels and histiocytes interrupt the infiltrate, and no residual follicles or T-cell zones are apparent. CD20 establishes B-cell lineage but is not specific for subtype. In conjunction with cyclin D1 and CD5 positivity, findings are consistent with mantle cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: CLL/SLL shows dim CD20, proliferation centers, and LEF1/CD23 positivity without cyclin D1.
FL cells are CD10/BCL6 positive and cyclin D1 negative, typically with CD21-positive dendritic meshworks.
MZL has monocytoid cells and plasmacytic differentiation and is CD5 and cyclin D1 negative.

60393.recognize_zh: 這是臨床照片與 CT 合成圖：腹部皮膚有中央黑色壞死、周圍紅暈的病灶，右腳大拇趾紅腫；CT 冠狀切面可見肝、脾病灶（箭頭），胸部 CT 有兩側下肺實質化病灶，在嗜中性球低下的 AML 患者中，符合侵襲性黴菌（mucormycosis）播散。
features: Panel A: abdominal skin plaque with central dark violaceous/black necrotic eschar and an erythematous halo
Panel B: erythema and swelling of the dorsal right great toe and first web space
Panel C: coronal contrast CT with arrows marking a subcapsular hepatic dome lesion and a heterogeneous splenic/left upper quadrant lesion
Panel D: axial chest CT (lung window) with a right lower lobe consolidation and a left lower lobe nodular opacity (arrows)
No microscopic morphology is shown; diagnosis rests on KOH/biopsy showing broad nonseptate hyphae
60393.describe_en: This composite of clinical photographs and computed tomography images shows an abdominal skin lesion with a central black necrotic eschar surrounded by an erythematous halo (A) and erythema of the right great toe (B). Coronal abdominal CT demonstrates focal hepatic and splenic lesions (C, arrows), and axial chest CT shows bibasilar pulmonary consolidation/nodular opacities (D, arrows). The figure is non-morphologic; in a profoundly neutropenic patient with relapsed AML, necrotic skin lesions with multiorgan involvement should prompt tissue biopsy, and demonstration of broad, ribbon-like, pauci-septate hyphae with right-angle branching supports disseminated mucormycosis.

ddx.vs: Aspergillus shows narrow, regularly septate hyphae with acute-angle (45 degree) dichotomous branching on biopsy, versus broad pauci-septate hyphae with right-angle branching in Mucorales.
Similar necrotic eschar in neutropenia, but tissue shows gram-negative bacilli in vessel walls without fungal hyphae, and blood cultures are usually positive.
Fusarium often yields positive blood cultures and septate hyaline hyphae with adventitial forms, unlike the nonseptate hyphae of mucormycosis.
Leukemic infiltrates form nodules or plaques without central necrotic eschar, and biopsy shows blasts rather than angioinvasive fungi.

60137.recognize_zh: 肥大細胞類胰蛋白酶（tryptase）免疫染色下，大量棕色陽性細胞以疏鬆、流線狀的方式散布於骨髓中，許多細胞呈拉長的紡錘形，而非緊密圓形聚集，這種紡錘形肥大細胞浸潤是PDGFRA重排腫瘤的特徵。
features: Numerous tryptase-positive cells with granular brown cytoplasmic staining
Many positive cells are elongated or spindle-shaped with oval nuclei; others are round to oval
Loose, streaming interstitial distribution rather than compact, well-circumscribed aggregates
Positive cells aligned along a fibrillary stroma, with negative (blue) background hematopoietic and stromal cells
Some weaker granular staining in the background may reflect eosinophils/basophils or dispersed granules
60137.describe_en: Mast cell tryptase immunohistochemistry on the bone marrow trephine section highlights a markedly increased number of mast cells. The mast cells are distributed in a loose, streaming interstitial pattern, and many are elongated and spindle-shaped, while others are round to oval; well-circumscribed dense aggregates are not a dominant feature. The surrounding hematopoietic and stromal cells are negative. The findings confirm a prominent spindled mast cell infiltrate, which in the setting of marked eosinophilia and FIP1L1::PDGFRA fusion is consistent with a myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with PDGFRA rearrangement; CD25 and KIT D816V testing help distinguish systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: SM characteristically forms compact multifocal aggregates of ≥15 mast cells and carries KIT D816V, whereas PDGFRA-rearranged neoplasms show looser, more diffuse spindled infiltrates without KIT D816V.
Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and CD25/CD2-negative without aggregates or spindle morphology.
Basophils are tryptase-weak or negative and are CD117-negative/CD123-positive, while mast cells are strongly tryptase and CD117-positive.
Stromal spindle cells in fibrosis are tryptase- and CD117-negative.

60073.recognize_zh: 兩張骨髓流式散射圖：FSC 對 SSC 與 CD45 對 SSC 中，細胞以高 SSC 的顆粒球（淺藍）為主，在 CD45 陰性、低 SSC 的區域（正常有核紅血球所在位置）幾乎沒有事件；表示流式上看不到紅血球系前驅細胞，支持 Diamond-Blackfan anemia 的紅系缺乏。
features: FSC vs SSC: large granulocytic population (light blue) with high SSC; small low-FSC/low-SSC lymphocyte cluster and gray debris
CD45 vs SSC: granulocytes CD45 moderate, monocytes (green) intermediate SSC, lymphocytes (red) CD45 bright low SSC
Absence of a CD45-negative, low-SSC cluster corresponding to nucleated erythroid precursors
Minimal dark-blue CD45-dim low-SSC events without a discrete blast population
60073.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of bone marrow is shown as forward versus side scatter and CD45 versus side scatter plots. The events consist predominantly of high side-scatter granulocytes with smaller monocyte and CD45-bright lymphocyte populations. The CD45-negative, low side-scatter region, where nucleated erythroid precursors normally cluster, is essentially empty, and no discrete CD45-dim blast population is evident. These findings indicate a marked paucity of erythroid precursors with myeloid predominance, supporting the diagnosis of Diamond-Blackfan anemia in correlation with aspirate morphology; lysis and hemodilution artifacts should be considered before interpreting absent erythroid events.

ddx.vs: Red cell lysis steps and hemodilution reduce nucleated red cells on flow; true hypoplasia must be confirmed on the aspirate differential.

ddx.dx: Transient erythroblastopenia of childhood / parvovirus B19 aplasia
ddx.vs: Yield an identical flow pattern and are distinguished by age, MCV, HbF, eADA, B19 PCR, and ribosomal protein gene testing.

60009.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數顆母細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、有核仁與一圈嗜鹼性無顆粒細胞質，周圍大量不同成熟階段的紅系前驅細胞，底部還有一顆核分葉的紅系細胞（紅系發育不良）；母細胞增加加上發育不良背景，符合 AML-MRC。
features: Several blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, one or more nucleoli, and a rim of basophilic agranular cytoplasm
Abundant erythroid precursors at polychromatic and orthochromatic stages with dense round nuclei
Lobulated or multinucleated erythroid precursor at bottom indicating dyserythropoiesis
Occasional granular cells with irregular nuclei, possibly promyelocytes or smudged granulocytes
No Auer rods identified
60009.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows increased blasts with high nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, visible nucleoli, and scant to moderate basophilic agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not seen. The blasts are admixed with numerous erythroid precursors, including a precursor with nuclear lobation consistent with dyserythropoiesis. Occasional granular myeloid cells are also present. The blast count cannot be determined from a single field and requires a 500-cell differential; with the reported 26% blasts and dysplasia, the findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with myelodysplasia-related changes.

ddx.vs: MDS-EB shows identical dysplasia but fewer than 20% blasts on the aspirate differential, so the distinction rests on blast enumeration rather than morphology of individual cells.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, rather than myeloblasts accompanied by maturing normoblasts.
Megaloblastic erythroid precursors show open sieve-like chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony without an expanded myeloblast population.

ddx.dx: AML with mutated NPM1 or other defining genetic abnormality
ddx.vs: Multilineage dysplasia alone does not qualify for AML-MRC when NPM1 or biallelic CEBPA mutation is present, so molecular testing is required.

28905.recognize_zh: 抹片中原始/前骨髓細胞胞質豐富嗜鹼、布滿粗大嗜天青顆粒，外觀很像急性前骨髓細胞白血病；但 RARA break-apart FISH 在中期染色體上兩個訊號均維持融合（未分離），排除 RARA 重組，符合經 G-CSF 刺激的非 APL 型 AML。
features: Cluster of large myeloid cells with moderate-to-abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm and prominent coarse azurophilic granulation (panel A)
Round to oval nuclei with fine-to-intermediate chromatin; nuclei are not bilobed or folded as in hypogranular APL
Cytoplasmic blebs/pseudopods at the cell margins; no Auer rod bundles (faggot cells) identified
RARA break-apart FISH on a metaphase showing two intact fused (colocalized) signal pairs on chromosome 17, indicating no RARA rearrangement (panel B)
28905.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large myeloid cells with abundant basophilic cytoplasm heavily packed with coarse azurophilic granules and round to oval nuclei with relatively fine chromatin, closely resembling abnormal promyelocytes; bilobed nuclei and faggot cells are not identified. Metaphase FISH with a RARA (17q21) break-apart probe shows two colocalized signal pairs without split signals, excluding a RARA rearrangement. In a patient who received filgrastim, the hypergranular appearance reflects G-CSF-induced maturation and granulation of leukemic blasts, and findings support acute myeloid leukemia other than acute promyelocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL shows bilobed or reniform nuclei, faggot cells and a RARA split/PML::RARA fusion signal, whereas the RARA break-apart probe here is intact.
G-CSF effect alone shows a maturing spectrum with toxic granulation and no increase in blasts, whereas leukemic AML shows a clonal, maturation-arrested blast population.
AML with t(8;21) has blasts with salmon-colored Golgi zones, single slender Auer rods and dysplastic neutrophils, confirmed by RUNX1::RUNX1T1.
Variant APL would still show separation of the RARA break-apart probe, which is absent here.

28649.recognize_zh: 周邊血與骨髓抹片中的大型淋巴樣細胞，核分成多葉呈花瓣狀或苜蓿葉狀（flower cell），胞質嗜鹼帶小空泡，組織切片也見多葉核大細胞（箭頭），在老年男性體重減輕盜汗的脈絡下代表白血病化的瀰漫性大 B 細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical lymphoid cell in blood with a deeply convoluted multilobated, flower-like nucleus and coarse chromatin (panel A)
Large cells with cloverleaf/multilobated nuclei, moderate deeply basophilic cytoplasm and scattered small vacuoles in the smear (panel B)
Tissue section with large pleomorphic cells including a cell with a petal-like multilobated nucleus (arrow) in a vacuolated/edematous background (panel C)
Normal neutrophil and red cells for size comparison; the atypical cells are roughly 2-3 times red cell diameter
28649.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows circulating large atypical lymphoid cells with markedly convoluted, multilobated 'flower-like' nuclei and coarse chromatin. The aspirate/smear contains similar large cells with cloverleaf nuclei and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. The tissue biopsy shows an infiltrate of large pleomorphic cells, including cells with petal-shaped multilobated nuclei. Although flower cells are classically associated with adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma, immunophenotyping demonstrating a mature B-cell phenotype supports diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in leukemic phase with flower cell morphology.

ddx.vs: ATLL flower cells are CD4+/CD25+ T cells with HTLV-1 serology positivity, whereas these cells carry a B-cell phenotype (CD19/CD20+).
Sézary cells are smaller with cerebriform grooved rather than petal-lobated nuclei, CD4+ with loss of CD7/CD26, and accompanied by erythroderma.
Monocytic cells have lacy chromatin, grey-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and CD14/lysozyme expression, not the dense chromatin of lymphoma cells.
Hypogranular APL cells have bilobed butterfly nuclei with fine chromatin, occasional Auer rods and strong MPO positivity.

27497.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞內充滿大量 2–4 µm、卵圓形、帶透明暈圈並有偏心深染小點的酵母菌（Histoplasma capsulatum），右圖另一巨噬細胞同時吞噬紅血球系細胞（hemophagocytosis）——同時具備組織胞漿菌感染與噬血現象。
features: Macrophages distended by numerous small (2–4 µm) oval intracellular yeasts
Yeasts show a crescent-shaped basophilic nucleus/dot with a surrounding clear halo (pseudocapsule artifact)
Panel B: macrophage containing an engulfed erythroid cell/red cell together with yeasts (hemophagocytosis)
Background of hematopoietic precursors including erythroid and granulocytic cells
No budding hyphae or kinetoplasts identified
27497.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered macrophages packed with numerous small, oval, intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2–4 µm, each with an eccentric basophilic chromatin crescent and a clear halo (A). A macrophage in panel B contains a phagocytosed erythroid cell together with yeast forms, indicating hemophagocytosis. No kinetoplasts are seen. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis with associated hemophagocytosis, supporting secondary hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context; confirmation by GMS/PAS stain, culture or urine/serum Histoplasma antigen is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have both a nucleus and a rod-shaped kinetoplast and lack a halo, and they do not stain with GMS/PAS.
Talaromyces yeasts are slightly larger, elongated, and divide by fission with a central transverse septum rather than budding.
Tachyzoites are crescent/banana-shaped, lack a halo and are GMS-negative.
Cryptococcus is larger (4–10 µm) with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule, and Candida shows pseudohyphae with budding.

exam.answer_en: Disseminated histoplasmosis with hemophagocytosis (secondary HLH) — macrophages packed with 2–4 µm haloed yeasts, one also engulfing an erythroid cell
pearls_zh: 考法：指著巨噬細胞內小圓體問「是什麼病原？怎麼和 Leishmania 分？」→ Histoplasma capsulatum，有透明暈、無 kinetoplast。
確認：GMS 或 PAS 染色陽性、培養；urine/serum Histoplasma antigen 對播散性感染敏感度高。
感染是 secondary HLH 常見誘因（HIV 病人尤其），HLH 診斷仍需符合臨床與實驗室標準，治療重點在控制感染。
播散性重症以 liposomal amphotericin B 誘導，之後改 itraconazole 維持。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 Leishmania amastigote 混淆；Leishmania 除核外有桿狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈且 GMS 陰性，Histoplasma 有暈且 GMS 陽性。

quiz.q: 巨噬細胞內 2–4 µm、帶透明暈的酵母菌為何？右圖同時出現的吞噬紅系細胞現象稱為？

22441.recognize_zh: 這是周邊血液流式細胞圖（FLAER 對 CD55/CD59）：A 為正常對照，99.75% 細胞 FLAER 與 CD55/59 皆陽性；B 病人有 97.84% 細胞兩者皆陰性，代表 GPI 錨定蛋白缺失的大型 PNH 克隆。
features: Two-parameter dot plots: FITC-FLAER (x-axis) versus PE-CD55/CD59 (y-axis)
Panel A: single population in the upper right quadrant (99.75% FLAER+/CD55-59+), a normal GPI-anchor pattern
Panel B: dominant population in the lower left quadrant (97.84% FLAER-negative/CD55-59-negative)
Panel B: small residual FLAER+/CD55-59+ normal population (0.47%) and a minor CD55/59-partial population
Lineage gate is not labeled on the plot
22441.describe_en: Flow cytometric analysis of peripheral blood compares FLAER binding with CD55/CD59 expression. In the control plot (A), virtually all events (99.75%) are FLAER-positive and CD55/CD59-positive. In the patient sample (B), 97.84% of gated events are negative for both FLAER and CD55/CD59, with only a tiny residual normal population. Findings indicate a large glycosylphosphatidylinositol (GPI)-anchor-deficient clone consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria; clone size should be reported separately for granulocytes, monocytes and red cells (type II/III) per high-sensitivity guidelines.

ddx.dx: Aplastic anemia with a small PNH clone
ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia typically harbors small clones (often <10%), whereas this plot shows a near-total GPI-deficient population.

ddx.dx: Recent transfusion masking a red-cell PNH clone
ddx.vs: Transfused normal red cells dilute the red-cell clone, so granulocyte FLAER analysis, as used here, is more reliable.

ddx.dx: Congenital CD59 or CD55 deficiency (Inab phenotype)
ddx.vs: Isolated inherited deficiency affects a single antigen on all cells while FLAER binding remains normal.

exam.answer_en: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria — flow cytometry shows a large FLAER-negative, CD55/CD59-negative GPI-anchor-deficient clone (97.84%) vs normal control
pearls_zh: 判讀：看右下（FLAER−/CD55−CD59−）象限比例即 PNH 克隆大小；對照組幾乎全落在雙陽性象限。報告應分別列出 granulocyte、monocyte 與 RBC 克隆大小。
FLAER 結合 GPI 錨本身，用於白血球（granulocyte 常搭配 CD24、monocyte 搭配 CD14）；紅血球不用 FLAER，改以 CD59 區分 type I/II/III。
近期輸血或溶血會使 RBC 克隆被低估，granulocyte 克隆較能反映真實大小；機轉為造血幹細胞體細胞 PIGA 突變。
臨床連結：血管內溶血、血栓（Budd-Chiari 等不尋常部位）、骨髓衰竭；aplastic anemia 常合併小 PNH 克隆，應常規篩檢。
治療：C5 抑制劑 eculizumab/ravulizumab（需打 meningococcal 疫苗）；其後可出現 C3 介導的血管外溶血（DAT C3d+），近端抑制劑如 pegcetacoplan、iptacopan 可改善。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 Ham test/sucrose lysis 當首選或把 RBC 克隆小誤判為克隆小；目前標準是高敏感度 flow（FLAER 與 CD59），輸血後 RBC 克隆會被稀釋，應以 granulocyte 結果為準。

quiz.q: 圖 B 中 97.84% 細胞同時 FLAER 陰性、CD55/CD59 陰性，代表缺失什麼結構？是哪個基因的體細胞突變所致？
quiz.a: GPI（glycosylphosphatidylinositol）錨定蛋白缺失；PIGA 基因突變，診斷 PNH。

19433.recognize_zh: 這是 NK/T 細胞淋巴瘤治療流程圖（非型態圖）：依局限鼻型、局限非鼻型與瀰漫性分流；局限鼻型能接受化療者用化放療合併（夾心式或同步），不適合化療者單純放療；非鼻型與瀰漫性用含 L-asparaginase 的 SMILE 方案，完全緩解可考慮造血幹細胞移植。
features: Entry point: newly diagnosed NK/T-cell lymphoma split into localized nasal, localized non-nasal, and disseminated disease
Localized nasal, chemotherapy fit: sequential chemoradiotherapy (SMILE or LVP with sandwiched RT) or concurrent chemoradiotherapy (2/3 DeVIC with RT, or RT plus cisplatin followed by VIPD)
Localized nasal, chemotherapy unfit: radiotherapy alone
Localized non-nasal and disseminated disease: systemic SMILE with or without RT, with consideration of HSCT in complete remission
Relapsed/refractory disease: SMILE with or without RT or L-asparaginase-containing regimens with non-MDR-dependent drugs, considering HSCT if CR
19433.describe_en: This figure is a non-morphologic treatment algorithm for extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma. Patients with localized nasal disease who are fit for chemotherapy receive combined-modality therapy, either sequential (SMILE or LVP with sandwiched radiotherapy) or concurrent (2/3 DeVIC with radiotherapy, or radiotherapy with cisplatin followed by VIPD), while unfit patients receive radiotherapy alone. Localized non-nasal and disseminated disease are treated with systemic SMILE with or without radiotherapy, with hematopoietic stem cell transplantation considered in complete remission. Relapsed or refractory disease is treated with SMILE or other L-asparaginase-based regimens using drugs not affected by P-glycoprotein-mediated multidrug resistance, again with HSCT considered upon complete remission.

19369.recognize_zh: 同一視野左側為大片單調、核小而圓、深染的小淋巴球（CLL/SLL），右側則是界線分明的大型上皮樣腫瘤細胞，細胞質豐富淡粉紅、核多形且有明顯核仁（黑色素瘤），兩種腫瘤直接相鄰，即所謂碰撞腫瘤（collision tumor）。
features: Two distinct populations sharply juxtaposed within the same section
Left: diffuse sheet of monotonous small lymphocytes with round dark nuclei, clumped chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, with small vessels coursing through
Right: cohesive nests and sheets of large epithelioid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Tumor cells with pleomorphic vesicular nuclei, prominent eosinophilic nucleoli, and occasional binucleation or intranuclear pseudoinclusions
No obvious melanin pigment in this field; scattered red cells in between
19369.describe_en: Section stained with H&E shows two morphologically distinct neoplastic populations in direct contact. One consists of a diffuse sheet of monotonous small lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm, consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma. The other is composed of large, discohesive-to-nested epithelioid cells with abundant pale eosinophilic cytoplasm, pleomorphic vesicular nuclei, and prominent nucleoli, without obvious melanin pigment in this field. Findings are consistent with a collision of CLL/SLL and metastatic melanoma; confirmation with CD5/CD23/CD20 for the lymphoid component and S100, SOX10, HMB-45, or Melan-A for the epithelioid component is recommended.

ddx.dx: Richter transformation (large B-cell lymphoma arising in CLL)
ddx.vs: Large transformed B cells form discohesive sheets with centroblastic or immunoblastic nuclei and express CD20/PAX5, whereas melanoma cells are cohesive, S100/SOX10-positive, and CD45-negative.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg-like cells are scattered singly in a mixed inflammatory background and are CD30/CD15-positive rather than forming cohesive epithelioid nests.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma in a lymph node with SLL
ddx.vs: Carcinoma also forms cohesive epithelioid nests but expresses cytokeratins and lacks S100/SOX10 and melanocytic markers.
ALCL hallmark cells have horseshoe-shaped nuclei and are CD30 and often ALK positive with sinusoidal spread, rather than S100-positive melanocytic cells.

18665.recognize_zh: 九格周邊血拼圖整理「淋巴系白血球增多」：可見胞質寬大灰藍、邊緣貼附紅血球的反應性淋巴球，也有核圓、染色質粗塊、胞質極少的小型成熟淋巴球，以及核較不規則或具核仁的異常淋巴球；判讀重點在區分多形性（反應性）與單一形態（腫瘤性）族群。
features: A, C: low-power fields with medium to large lymphocytes having abundant pale blue cytoplasm
B, I: small mature-appearing lymphocytes with round dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
D, E: lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, condensed chromatin, and some with visible nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
F, H: lymphocytes with moderate pale cytoplasm, some with eccentric nuclei
G: large reactive lymphocytes with abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm scalloping around adjacent red cells, beside a neutrophil
18665.describe_en: This composite of peripheral blood smears illustrates the spectrum of lymphoid leukocytosis. Panels include large lymphocytes with abundant basophilic cytoplasm that indents around adjacent red cells, typical of reactive (e.g., EBV-associated) lymphocytosis, and monotonous small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and scant cytoplasm, as seen in chronic lymphocytic leukemia or other small B-cell neoplasms. Other panels show lymphocytes with nucleoli, irregular nuclei, or moderate cytoplasm that raise the possibility of prolymphocytes or lymphoma cells. The key morphologic principle is that a heterogeneous population favors a reactive process, whereas a monomorphic population warrants flow cytometry; individual panel diagnoses are not labeled in the image and cannot be confirmed from morphology alone.

ddx.vs: Reactive lymphocytes are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm hugging red cells, whereas CLL cells are monotonous small cells with soccer-ball chromatin, smudge cells, and a CD5/CD23 clonal B-cell phenotype.
LGL cells have moderate pale cytoplasm with coarse azurophilic granules and a clonal CD3/CD8/CD57 T-cell or NK phenotype.

ddx.dx: Leukemic mantle cell or follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: These show irregular or cleaved nuclei with clonal B-cell phenotype (cyclin D1 or CD10/BCL2), requiring flow cytometry and FISH to separate from CLL.
Pertussis produces small mature lymphocytes with cleaved nuclei in children that are polyclonal on flow cytometry.

exam.answer_en: Lymphoid leukocytosis composite — heterogeneous reactive lymphocytes (reactive process) versus monomorphic small or nucleolated lymphocytes (lymphoproliferative neoplasm)
pearls_zh: 考法：拼圖中考官指某格問「反應性或腫瘤性」；原則：多形性（大小、細胞質差異大）偏反應性，單一形態偏腫瘤性，需做 flow cytometry。
反應性淋巴球（如 EBV 傳染性單核球增多症）：細胞質寬大深藍、邊緣包繞紅血球；以 heterophile antibody 或 EBV VCA IgM 確認。
成人持續性單一形態小淋巴球增多先做 flow：CD5+CD23+ 考慮 CLL；CD5+CD23− 須排除 MCL（cyclin D1）；CD10+ 考慮 follicular lymphoma。
LGL leukemia：細胞質有嗜天青顆粒，T-LGL 表型 CD3+CD8+CD57+，常有 STAT3 突變，合併嗜中性球低下與類風濕性關節炎。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把 EBV 等病毒引起的大型反應性淋巴球誤判為 lymphoma 或 blast；反應性淋巴球形態連續多樣、細胞質包繞紅血球，腫瘤細胞則形態單一，最終以 flow 判斷克隆性。

quiz.q: 周邊血淋巴球增多時，哪一個形態整體特徵最能區分反應性與腫瘤性？若為單一形態，下一步檢查是什麼？
quiz.a: 多形性（heterogeneous）偏反應性、單一形態（monomorphic）偏腫瘤性；flow cytometry 評估克隆性。

18153.recognize_zh: 這是紅血球生成示意圖（非形態學影像），以電子顯微鏡照片呈現骨髓中 CFU-E、前紅血球母細胞到正染性紅血球母細胞的成熟過程，並標示各階段導致慢性貧血的機轉：EPO 依賴與 Fas 相關凋亡、DNA 合成障礙造成巨球性、血紅素調控抑制因子造成小球性。
features: Schematic of erythropoiesis from HSC and CMP to BFU-E and CFU-E in the bone marrow
Electron micrographs of proerythroblasts, basophilic, polychromatic, and orthochromatic erythroblasts showing progressive nuclear condensation and cell size reduction
Blood panels showing reticulocytes and mature biconcave red cells
Annotations: EPO dependence and increased Fas at CFU-E/proerythroblast stage; FasL, TRAIL, TNF-alpha leading to apoptotic erythroblasts
Annotations: impaired DNA synthesis causing macrocytosis and heme-regulated inhibitor causing microcytosis during hemoglobinization
18153.describe_en: This non-morphologic schematic depicts erythroid differentiation from hematopoietic stem cells through BFU-E and CFU-E to proerythroblasts, basophilic, polychromatic, and orthochromatic erythroblasts, reticulocytes, and mature red cells, illustrated with electron micrographs. It maps mechanisms of chronic anemia to specific stages: the EPO-dependent CFU-E to early erythroblast stages are vulnerable to apoptosis mediated by FasL, TRAIL, and TNF-alpha, as in anemia of inflammation; DNA damage and impaired DNA synthesis in later stages cause macrocytosis; and unpaired globins, oxidative damage, and heme-regulated inhibitor activity during hemoglobinization cause microcytosis. The key concept is that the stage at which erythropoiesis fails determines red cell size and the type of anemia.

15145.recognize_zh: 這是周邊血形態比較表：每一列列出一種脾臟相關淋巴瘤（HCL、SMZL、MCL、LPL、B-PLL、FL、T-LGL、HSTL）的文字特徵與兩張代表細胞，重點在比較毛狀突起分布、極性絨毛、核仁、核溝與顆粒等細節來區分。
features: HCL: oval eccentric nuclei with reticular chromatin and abundant pale cytoplasm bearing fine, evenly distributed projections
SMZL: medium-sized lymphocytes with round nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm showing thick polar villi
MCL: indented nuclei with condensed chromatin, plus larger blastoid cells with one or two nucleoli; LPL: plasmacytoid lymphocytes with basophilic cytoplasm
B-PLL: medium to large cells with a prominent vesicular nucleolus and regular nuclear outline
FL: small cells with markedly irregular contours and deep nuclear grooves ('buttock cells'); T-LGL: ample cytoplasm with azurophilic granules
HSTL: medium to large atypical lymphocytes with irregular nuclei, prominent nucleoli and sometimes scattered granules
15145.describe_en: This is a comparative reference panel of peripheral blood smears (May-Grunwald-Giemsa, x630) showing two representative neoplastic cells for each of eight lymphomas that commonly involve the spleen, each paired with a text description. The panel shows hairy cells with circumferential fine projections (HCL), villous lymphocytes with thick polar villi (SMZL), and indented and blastoid cells (MCL). It also shows plasmacytoid lymphocytes (LPL), prolymphocytes with prominent vesicular nucleoli (B-PLL), cleaved 'buttock' cells (FL), granular lymphocytes (T-LGL) and atypical nucleolated cells (HSTL). The images are small, so fine details such as granules and villi are only partly resolved. The panel is best used to learn the morphologic clues that point toward a specific entity, with confirmation always requiring flow cytometry and genetic studies.

ddx.vs: HCL projections are fine and circumferential, while SMZL villi are short, thick and polar, and only HCL is CD103/CD25/CD123/annexin A1-positive.

ddx.dx: B-PLL (splenic B-cell leukemia with prominent nucleoli) vs blastoid MCL
ddx.vs: Both show nucleolated cells, but MCL is CD5+ with cyclin D1/t(11;14), which must be excluded before diagnosing prolymphocytic leukemia.

ddx.dx: T-LGL vs reactive large granular lymphocytes
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical, so clonality requires flow (CD57, KIR restriction), TCR rearrangement or STAT3 mutation.

exam.answer_en: Comparative PB panel of splenic lymphomas — HCL circumferential hairs, SMZL polar villi, MCL indented/blastoid, B-PLL nucleoli, FL cleaved, T-LGL granules
pearls_zh: 考法：給一顆周邊血淋巴細胞問最可能哪一種；絨毛分布是重點：HCL 整圈細毛、SMZL 兩極粗短絨毛、HCL-v 型態介於 HCL 與 prolymphocyte 之間且有明顯核仁。
HCL：CD11c、CD25、CD103、CD123 陽性，BRAF V600E；SMZL：CD5−、CD10−、CD103 通常陰性，約三成有 del(7q)；MCL：CD5+、cyclin D1+、SOX11+，t(11;14)。
LPL：漿細胞樣淋巴細胞，多數有 MYD88 L265P，常伴 IgM paraprotein；FL：核裂「buttock cell」，CD10+、BCL2+，t(14;18) IGH::BCL2。
T 細胞：T-LGL 為 CD3+CD8+CD57+、常有 STAT3 突變，合併中性球減少與 RA；HSTL 為 γδ T 細胞、i(7q)。
WHO 5th 已取消 B-PLL 與 HCL-v 名稱，相關病例改歸 splenic B-cell lymphoma/leukemia with prominent nucleoli。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常混淆 HCL 與 SMZL 的絨毛細胞：HCL 胞質豐富、細毛環繞整圈且核仁不明顯；SMZL 胞質較少、絨毛集中在一或兩極；確認仍需 flow（CD103/CD25/CD11c/CD123）。

quiz.q: 周邊血淋巴細胞胞質絨毛只集中在細胞一極且粗短，最可能是哪一種脾臟淋巴瘤？

12649.recognize_zh: HIV 病人尿液抹片（A）出現成群的大型漿母細胞樣（plasmablastic）細胞，胞質深藍、有空泡，核大且有明顯核仁；B 圖免疫染色呈細點狀核染色（典型 HHV-8 LANA 型態），提示腔外型原發性滲出液淋巴瘤（extracavitary PEL）。
features: Large cohesive-appearing clusters of large atypical lymphoid cells, several times the size of admixed inflammatory cells
Round to irregular nuclei with open chromatin and prominent nucleoli; some binucleate or pleomorphic forms
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with vacuoles (plasmablastic/immunoblastic appearance)
Background degenerating neutrophils and debris typical of urine cytology
IHC panel: granular, dot-like (stippled) nuclear positivity in nearly all tumor cells, pattern characteristic of HHV-8 LANA-1
12649.describe_en: Urine cytology cytospin shows numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with high N:C ratio, open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and deeply basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, admixed with degenerating neutrophils. The cells lack epithelial cohesion features such as molding or keratinization. Immunohistochemistry on the corresponding material shows diffuse speckled nuclear staining in the tumor cells, a pattern typical of HHV-8 (LANA-1). In an HIV-positive patient, findings are consistent with extracavitary primary effusion lymphoma involving the urinary tract; confirmation with CD45, CD138/MUM1, lack of B-cell markers and EBER ISH is advised.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells show cohesive groups, hyperchromatic coarse chromatin and keratin/GATA3 positivity, whereas PEL cells are discohesive, CD45/CD138 positive and HHV-8 LANA positive.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has similar morphology but is HHV-8 negative and usually EBER positive with MYC rearrangement, while PEL shows nuclear HHV-8 LANA staining.
HHV-8-positive DLBCL is typically IgM-lambda, EBV-negative and expresses CD20 in some cases, whereas PEL is usually EBV co-infected and lacks surface B-cell markers.

6377.recognize_zh: 一群大型細胞核偏位、細胞質豐富且深藍，部分可見核旁淡染區（perinuclear hof），核染色質較粗、偶見核仁與雙核細胞，屬漿母細胞（plasmablast）形態，符合漿母細胞淋巴瘤。
features: Large atypical cells, roughly two to three times the size of the adjacent neutrophil, clustered together
Eccentric round to oval nuclei with moderate N:C ratio; occasional binucleate cell
Coarsely granular to vesicular chromatin with visible nucleoli in some cells
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, with a paranuclear pale hof in several cells
Occasional small cytoplasmic vacuoles; background red cells, a neutrophil and a granulated cell
6377.describe_en: Smear shows an aggregate of large atypical plasmacytoid cells in a background of red cells and scattered granulocytes. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse to vesicular chromatin and occasional nucleoli, and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, several with a paranuclear hof; a binucleate form is present. The cells are considerably larger and more immature than mature plasma cells. Findings are consistent with plasmablastic lymphoma in the appropriate context; correlation with CD138/MUM1 positivity, loss of CD20/PAX5, EBER ISH and MYC status is recommended.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with plasmablastic morphology
ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; myeloma is favored by a serum/urine M-protein, lytic bone lesions and a prior myeloma history, while plasmablastic lymphoma is more often EBER-positive and extramedullary in immunodeficient patients.
PEL shows similar immunoblastic-plasmablastic cells but arises in body cavity effusions and is HHV8 (LANA-1) positive.
It shares the plasmablastic phenotype but shows granular cytoplasmic ALK staining, usually from CLTC::ALK.
Immunoblasts have a single central prominent nucleolus and retain CD20 and PAX5, which plasmablastic lymphoma lacks.

exam.answer_en: Plasmablastic lymphoma — aggregate of large immature plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, nucleoli and deeply basophilic cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指體積大、偏心核、深藍胞質並見核仁與雙核的細胞，問「是漿細胞還是淋巴瘤」；形態像漿母細胞，但免疫表型是關鍵。
表型：CD138、CD38、MUM1/IRF4 陽性，CD20 與 PAX5 陰性或弱，Ki-67 高；常有胞質輕鏈限制。EBER ISH 多數陽性，HHV8 陰性。
臨床：好發於 HIV 或其他免疫低下者，典型部位為口腔，也可見於結外部位；MYC 重排常見且與較差預後相關。
CD20 陰性，因此 rituximab 不適用；整體預後差，常用 CHOP 以上強度化療，HIV 病人需同時 ART。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最易誤認為 plasmablastic plasma cell myeloma：兩者形態與表型重疊，myeloma 通常 EBER 陰性、有 M protein、CRAB/溶骨病灶；PBL 常 EBER 陽性並有免疫低下背景。PEL 則 HHV8 陽性。

quiz.q: HIV 病人出現圖中大型漿母細胞樣細胞，CD20 陰性、CD138 陽性，哪一項原位雜交最有助於支持 plasmablastic lymphoma？

1385.recognize_zh: 低倍淋巴結 H&E 可見被膜下的大型濾泡，生發中心邊界不規則、套細胞層變薄，小型深染淋巴球呈團塊狀侵入生發中心（箭頭，濾泡溶解 follicle lysis），這是 HIV 相關淋巴結病變的特徵；圖片本身並非顯示血小板低下。
features: Lymph node with intact fibrous capsule and a large expanded lymphoid follicle
Germinal center with irregular outline containing pale tingible-body macrophages and scattered pink histiocytic/dendritic cells
Attenuated, poorly defined mantle zone
Clusters of small dark lymphocytes infiltrating and disrupting the germinal center (arrow), consistent with follicle lysis
No monotonous neoplastic infiltrate or granulomas evident at this magnification
1385.describe_en: Section of lymph node shows an intact capsule and a markedly enlarged follicle with an irregular germinal center, attenuated mantle zone and scattered tingible-body macrophages. Aggregates of small mantle lymphocytes infiltrate and fragment the germinal center (arrow), a pattern termed follicle lysis. No neoplastic infiltrate is identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with florid follicular hyperplasia with follicle lysis, characteristic of HIV-associated lymphadenopathy; the image does not directly demonstrate thrombocytopenia but reflects the immune dysregulation underlying HIV-related immune thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Follicles have well-preserved mantle zones without mantle lymphocyte invasion or germinal center fragmentation.
Crowded monotonous follicles lacking tingible-body macrophages and polarity, with BCL2-positive germinal centers.
Shows regressed hyalinized germinal centers with onion-skin mantles or sheets of interfollicular plasma cells; HHV-8 staining in HIV-associated multicentric disease.
Spindle-cell proliferation with slit-like vascular spaces and HHV-8 LANA positivity.

2921.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，腫瘤細胞核卵圓至略呈梭形、染色質細緻、部分可見小核仁，細胞質稀少，散在淡粉紅色纖維狀神經氈（neuropil-like）基質中；少數細胞核略大、染色質較淡，但未見成熟節細胞。
features: Small to intermediate cells with oval to slightly spindled nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Fine to salt-and-pepper chromatin; some larger nuclei with vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli
Loose arrangement in pale pink fibrillary (neuropil-like) background
Occasional pyknotic or apoptotic nuclei
No mature ganglion cells with abundant cytoplasm in this field
2921.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows a loosely cohesive population of small to intermediate cells with oval to slightly spindled nuclei, fine chromatin, and scant cytoplasm, set within pale eosinophilic fibrillary stroma resembling neuropil. A subset of cells has slightly enlarged vesicular nuclei with small nucleoli, which may represent early differentiating neuroblasts, and occasional apoptotic nuclei are present. Mature ganglion cells with abundant cytoplasm are not seen in this field. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastoma in the marrow, with at most early neuroblastic differentiation evident in this image.

ddx.vs: Ewing sarcoma has uniform round nuclei in sheets without fibrillary neuropil and is CD99/NKX2.2 positive.

ddx.dx: Spindle cell sarcoma or schwannian stroma
ddx.vs: Schwannian stroma has wavy elongated nuclei in collagen and is S100 positive, whereas neuroblasts are PHOX2B positive with fibrillary neuropil.
Lymphoblasts have round to convoluted nuclei without neuropil and express TdT and T- or B-cell markers.

1193.recognize_zh: 胸水細胞抹片中，大量散在、互不黏連的大型異常細胞，核不規則且可見核仁，細胞質嗜鹼性並含多個小空泡，混有少數小淋巴球作為大小對照，符合大型 B 細胞淋巴瘤侵犯胸水。
features: Numerous discohesive large atypical cells, roughly 2-4 times the size of small lymphocytes
Irregular, folded to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and occasional nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm with multiple small clear vacuoles
Admixed small mature lymphocytes provide size comparison
Background of crenated (echinocytic) red cells, a cytospin artifact; no cohesive epithelial or mesothelial clusters
1193.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin shows a cellular specimen composed predominantly of discohesive large atypical cells admixed with small mature lymphocytes. The large cells have irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional nucleoli and basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm. No cohesive three-dimensional clusters suggestive of carcinoma or reactive mesothelial cells are seen. Findings are consistent with involvement by a large B-cell lymphoma; flow cytometry or cell block immunostaining is required to confirm B-cell lineage and exclude histiocytes.

ddx.vs: Macrophages have bean-shaped nuclei with abundant foamy cytoplasm and mesothelial cells show windows and dense cytoplasm, whereas these are monomorphic large cells with nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm.
PEL cells are often plasmablastic/anaplastic, lack B-cell antigens (CD19/CD20) and are HHV8/LANA-positive, whereas LBCL expresses pan-B-cell markers.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters or acini and is keratin-positive and CD45-negative.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized, uniform, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and sharp lipid vacuoles and a Ki-67 near 100% with MYC rearrangement.

1257.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一團細胞被大量藍黑色細小粉末狀黑色素顆粒覆蓋，右側一個大型腫瘤細胞具明顯大核仁與豐富灰藍色細胞質，背景中有散落的色素顆粒，符合黑色素瘤骨髓轉移。
features: Aggregate of cells heavily laden with fine, dusty blue-black melanin pigment, partly obscuring nuclei
Large atypical cell with an oval nucleus, prominent nucleolus and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm
Additional large cell with vesicular chromatin and a distinct nucleolus
Extracellular pigment granules scattered in the background
Background degenerated hematopoietic cells, including smudged nuclei and neutrophils
1257.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a group of cells heavily laden with fine blue-black pigment, with similar granules dispersed in the background. Nearby are large atypical cells with oval nuclei, vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and abundant grey-blue cytoplasm, unlike normal marrow elements. Residual hematopoietic cells show degenerative smudging. Findings are suggestive of metastatic melanoma to the bone marrow, to be confirmed by immunohistochemistry for melanocytic markers.

ddx.vs: Hemosiderin is Prussian blue-positive and lies within bland macrophages, whereas melanin is Prussian blue-negative and associated with atypical nucleolated tumor cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters without pigment and is keratin-positive and SOX10/S100-negative.
Osteoblasts have eccentric nuclei with a paranuclear hof away from the nucleus and lack cytoplasmic pigment or macronucleoli.

exam.answer_en: Metastatic melanoma in bone marrow — melanin-laden cell aggregate with large atypical cells showing prominent nucleoli
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著右側大細胞問「這是造血細胞嗎？」要答出非造血腫瘤細胞：大核、明顯大核仁、豐富灰藍胞質，並連結旁邊的 melanin 色素。
IHC 組合：SOX10、S100、Melan-A、HMB45 陽性，CD45 陰性；melanoma 可表現 CD117，勿誤判為肥大細胞或髓系。
分子：約半數皮膚 melanoma 帶 BRAF V600 突變，可用 BRAF/MEK inhibitor；轉移病人另可接受 immune checkpoint inhibitor（anti-PD-1 ± anti-CTLA-4）。
骨髓轉移常表現 leukoerythroblastic 血液圖（周邊出現有核紅血球與未成熟顆粒球）及骨髓纖維化，看到此血液圖要找骨髓浸潤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 大型核仁明顯的細胞易被誤認為 AML 芽細胞或骨母細胞（osteoblast）；腫瘤細胞成群、伴 melanin 色素且 CD45 陰性/SOX10 陽性，骨母細胞則為偏心核與核旁淡區、成排分布。

quiz.q: 圖中有大核仁的非造血腫瘤細胞，若懷疑 melanoma，哪個核染 IHC 標記最常用於確認？

1321.recognize_zh: 巨核細胞的核分裂成多個彼此分離的圓形核塊，排列在細胞周邊（類似 pawn-ball 樣分離核葉），在化療後骨髓中是巨核細胞的治療相關變化。
features: Large megakaryocyte with multiple widely separated, round nuclear lobes (detached lobes)
Nuclear lobes arranged in a ring around a central zone of pale, finely granular cytoplasm
Individual lobes with condensed but not pyknotic chromatin
Pale blue-gray cytoplasm with ill-defined borders
Background of scattered erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytes with abundant red cells and clumped platelets
1321.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte whose nucleus is fragmented into multiple discrete, rounded lobes that are separated from one another and arranged around a central cytoplasmic zone. The surrounding cells include erythroid precursors, lymphocytes and granulocytes; clumped platelets are present. In a patient after cytotoxic therapy, this megakaryocytic nuclear separation is consistent with chemotherapy effect and should not by itself be interpreted as myelodysplasia.

ddx.dx: Myelodysplastic neoplasm (megakaryocytes with multiple separated nuclei)
ddx.vs: In MDS, megakaryocytes with widely separated nuclei occur without recent cytotoxic exposure and are accompanied by persistent multilineage dysplasia and clonal abnormalities.

ddx.dx: Megakaryocyte in mitosis or apoptosis (naked/fragmented nuclei)
ddx.vs: Apoptotic megakaryocytes show pyknotic, dark nuclear fragments and a naked nucleus, whereas these lobes retain structured chromatin within intact cytoplasm.
Osteoclasts have many uniform, separate, round nuclei with nucleoli and abundant granular cytoplasm, and their nuclei are not lobes of a single polyploid nucleus.

1129.recognize_zh: 髓過氧化酶（MPO）細胞化學染色中，成熟中性球呈黃褐色陽性作為內部對照，而左側的芽細胞仍呈紫色、完全未著色（MPO 陰性），符合 AML 微分化型（M0）的 MPO 陰性芽細胞。
features: Segmented neutrophils with strong diffuse golden-brown cytoplasmic MPO reaction (internal positive control)
Blast with purple nucleus and cytoplasm lacking any brown granular reaction (MPO-negative)
Blast of moderate size with round nucleus and high N:C ratio
Background red cells with counterstain; platelets present
1129.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear stained for myeloperoxidase shows segmented neutrophils with strong golden-brown cytoplasmic positivity, serving as an internal positive control. A blast in the field shows no cytoplasmic MPO reactivity. Because fewer than 3% of blasts are MPO positive in AML with minimal differentiation, a negative MPO cytochemistry with valid internal controls is expected. Findings are consistent with MPO-negative blasts; myeloid lineage must be established by flow cytometry (e.g., CD13, CD33, CD117, CD34) with exclusion of lymphoid lineage.

ddx.vs: ALL blasts are also MPO negative, so separation requires flow cytometry showing B- or T-lineage markers versus myeloid markers.
Megakaryoblasts are MPO negative but express CD41/CD61.
Monoblasts can be MPO weak or negative but show strong nonspecific esterase positivity and monocytic markers such as CD14, CD64 and CD36.
In AML with maturation, at least 3% of blasts (usually many) are MPO positive, often with Auer rods.

exam.answer_en: AML with minimal differentiation (FAB M0) — MPO-negative blast with MPO-positive neutrophils as internal control
pearls_zh: 考法：考官問「這是什麼染色？芽細胞陽性或陰性？如何判讀有效？」重點是成熟中性球呈褐色陽性作為 internal control，芽細胞陰性。
定義：MPO（或 Sudan black B）陽性芽細胞 <3%，需以 flow 證明髓系抗原（CD13、CD33、CD117 中至少兩項）並排除 B/T 系（cyCD3、cyCD79a、CD22 等）。
鑑別：同為 MPO 陰性的還有 ALL、acute megakaryoblastic leukemia（CD41/CD61+）、acute monoblastic leukemia（non-specific esterase 陽性）；需 flow 與 NSE 區分。
AML-M0 預後較差，常見複雜核型與 RUNX1 突變；WHO 5th 仍保留「AML with minimal differentiation」作為依分化程度定義的類別（需無 defining genetic abnormality）。
exam.pitfall_zh: MPO 陰性易被誤判為 ALL；若 flow 無 B/T 系標記而 CD13/CD33/CD117 陽性即為 AML-M0，且務必確認中性球陽性，否則可能是染色失敗造成的偽陰性。

quiz.q: 圖中芽細胞 MPO 陰性、旁邊中性球陽性，下一步用什麼檢查來確認其髓系來源？
quiz.a: Flow cytometry（CD13、CD33、CD117 陽性，排除 cyCD3、cyCD79a 等淋巴系標記）

1065.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以前骨髓球與骨髓球為主，胞質含粗大、深紫紅色顆粒（箭頭），核周可見淡染的高基氏區（Golgi zone），成熟分葉嗜中性球少，呈現左移並伴毒性顆粒的反應性骨髓造血。
features: Predominance of promyelocytes and myelocytes (left-shifted granulopoiesis)
Coarse, dark purple-red azurophilic granules in the cytoplasm of promyelocytes (arrows), consistent with toxic-type granulation
Round to oval eccentric nuclei with perinuclear Golgi clearing in many cells
Occasional band and segmented neutrophils; no Auer rods seen
Crowded, dried red cell background typical of an aspirate smear
1065.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows granulocytic hyperplasia with a left shift, dominated by promyelocytes and myelocytes. Many cells contain coarse, darkly staining azurophilic granules (arrows) and show round to oval nuclei with a perinuclear Golgi hof. Band and segmented neutrophils are present in reduced numbers, and no Auer rods or faggot cells are identified. Findings are consistent with reactive left-shifted myelopoiesis with toxic granulation, as seen in infection, G-CSF therapy, or marrow recovery.

ddx.vs: APL promyelocytes have folded or bilobed nuclei without a Golgi hof, often contain Auer rod bundles, and lack subsequent maturation, and harbor PML::RARA.
CML shows a myelocyte and neutrophil peak with basophilia and eosinophilia in the blood and BCR::ABL1, rather than a transient promyelocyte-predominant left shift.
Chediak-Higashi shows giant, sparse, fused granules in granulocytes rather than numerous coarse dark azurophilic granules.

4201.recognize_zh: 脾臟掃描倍率H&E中，紅髓被瀰漫性細胞浸潤而擴張，白髓濾泡相對小而稀少（左上與左下的深色小區），只看得出架構變化，細胞細節需高倍確認。
features: Scanning magnification of spleen with diffusely expanded, densely cellular red pulp
Small, inconspicuous white pulp nodules (darker foci at upper and lower left)
Scattered small arterioles and trabecular vessels
No discrete tumor nodules, necrosis or infarcts at this power
Cytologic detail not assessable at this magnification
4201.describe_en: Section of spleen at scanning magnification shows diffuse expansion of the red pulp by a dense cellular infiltrate, with relatively small and inconspicuous white pulp nodules. No discrete nodules, necrosis or infarction are seen at this power. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The architecture is consistent with the red pulp expansion seen in infectious mononucleosis, but higher-power examination and ancillary studies are required to exclude lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Splenic involvement by lymphoma or leukemia
ddx.vs: Neoplastic infiltrates are monotonous on high power and show clonal immunophenotype, which cannot be assessed at this magnification.
Congestion shows red cell-filled cords and sinuses with fibrosis and Gamna-Gandy bodies rather than a dense lymphoid infiltrate.

4073.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中兩顆淋巴球體積較大，細胞質豐富淡藍色，下方那顆的細胞質邊緣嗜鹼性加深並貼附擠壓周圍紅血球，核呈凹陷或腎形、染色質較鬆，是反應性（variant）淋巴球的特徵。
